transcript: Last night, I went to Burnout Paradise at St Ann's Warehouse. This delightfully bizarre and hilariously ridiculous show created by the collective Pony Cam is essentially a race to complete a series of tasks all performed while on a treadmill. Each task falls under one of four categories: survival, admin, performance, and leisure. The show is divided into four 10-minute rotations. This simple but engaging structure keeps the stakes high and the chaos flowing. At any given moment, there are so many places to look and ways to get involved if you want to. The audience is an essential instrument in completing the tasks at hand. The whole thing is honestly super overstimulating in the best way possible and it's the kind of thing where no true performances are the same. If you're looking for something nontraditional, exciting, and straight up silly, Burnout Paradise is running, or should I say sprinting, at St Ann’s Warehouse through December 1st. With that, another program for my collection.
